title: I Was Blind, and Now I See

request.style: English, joyful gospel, male lead vocal with call-and-response choir, piano, Hammond organ, bass, drums, tambourine, uplifting, 110 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Born in the dark, I sat by the road
Begging for coins with a heavy load
He spat on the ground and he made some clay
He put it on my eyes and he said, go wash it away

[Verse]
I went to the pool and I washed my face
And light came pouring into that place
The neighbors asked, isn't this the beggar man
The leaders asked me who and how, they did not understand

[Chorus]
Whether he is a sinner I do not know
One thing I do know
I was blind, and now I see
I was blind, and now I see

[Verse]
They questioned my mother, they questioned me twice
They wanted an answer to fit their device
But all I can tell you is what he has done
He opened my eyes and I'm seeing the sun

[Chorus]
Whether he is a sinner I do not know
One thing I do know
I was blind, and now I see
I was blind, and now I see

[Outro]
I am the light of the world
I was blind, and now I see
